title: Cauliflower Buffalo Bites
description:
Want to know something that is hard? Not eating an entire batch of cauliflower buffalo bites. Because I could, they are dang good, and even, dare I say (?) good for you!!
Make the sauce and do your best not to taste it - I mean, definitely taste it but that's it, just one taste, don't be sticking your spoon back into the pot over and over again and don't even think about putting a straw in there!
ingredients: 2 large heads of cauliflower, washed, dried and cut into bite-size pieces
1/2 cup Frank's Red-Hot Wings Sauce (or another Buffalo Sauce.)
Blue cheese dressing, celery sticks and baby carrots, for serving, optional
directions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Line two rimmed baking sheets with parchment or foil. In a large bowl, toss cauliflower with olive oil and salt. Spread on prepared baking sheets; set the empty bowl aside. Roast the cauliflower until it starts to soften and brown a bit on the bottom, about 7 to 10 minutes.

Meanwhile, in the bowl, combine the Wings Sauce, brown sugar, melted butter, ketchup, onion powder, garlic and mix well. Add in the roasted cauliflower pieces and toss well to coat. Spread out cauliflower pieces, once again, on the baking sheets and bake in oven for an additional 7 to 10 minutes, or until starting to char just a bit. Remove and serve hot or at room temperature. Serve with your favorite Blue cheese dressing.
